stories.title: North Wales Police to get domestic abuse specialist in 999 control room under Raneem’s Law
stories.summary: Domestic abuse specialists are to be placed inside North Wales Police’s 999 control room under the second phase of a scheme set up after two women were murdered despite calling police for help. stories.title: Nine Welsh health and care organisations write to Welsh Government demanding action on corridor care
stories.summary: Nine health and care organisations have written to the Welsh Government’s health minister demanding urgent action on corridor care, the practice of treating patients in hospital corridors, waiting rooms and car parks because no clinical space is available.
